deployVault(address,address,uint256,uint.notice: Deploy a vault. The caller pays gas; `operator` (the mint's         key) controls the vault from birth — the factory and the caller         retain nothing. The publication policy (at least one rule) is a         deploy-time commitment: `publishThresholdBps` (publish when the         backing drifts more than X bps) and/or `publishIntervalBlocks`         (publish at least every X blocks).

isVault(address).notice: True iff the address was deployed by this factory.

vaults(uint256).notice: Every vault ever deployed, in order.
